name: Boss Encounter Script
description: Owns boss engagement, ordered phase transitions, enrage, scripted adds, resolution, failure, and reset. Legacy floor encounters may still use phaseThresholds, initialBeaten, and the original outputs. The optional encounters input adds stable phase ids and three explicit transition kinds: health fraction, elapsed fight time, or a matched condition event. Only the next declared phase can enter, every entered phase and spawned add is recorded once, and restoration resumes the ledger without replaying attacks, spawns, hazards, or rewards. The director announces boss and add unitSpawned records but Unit Roster alone owns board units and health; Enemy Tier Scaling supplies base level multipliers once. Boss and phase attacks are data for Elite Telegraph Scheduler, arena hazardPhase ids are data for Arena Hazards, and neither timing nor contact is implemented here. A matching boss entityDefeated produces bossDefeated and one bossEncounterCompleted with a stable completionId; that same ordinary defeat feeds existing XP, mastery, and loot consumers. Failure, reset, replay rejection, and post-completion cleanup use unitRemoved and cannot synthesize defeats or rewards. Boss Room Seal remains the door owner, Status Effects remains the timed-effect owner, and enrage publishes encounter state and replacement attacks rather than applying a status or final damage. Engagement, phase, and enrage payloads carry encounterId, arenaId, bossSpawnId, stable phaseId, attacks, and hazardPhase; completion carries encounterId, arenaId, bossSpawnId, defeatId, and completionId so arena, scheduler, room, mastery, and save consumers match facts without inferring ownership.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: phaseThresholds
inputs.description: Health fractions where the phase flips. Two thresholds is the classic three-act fight; the array is the whole design surface.

inputs.name: lockArenaOnEngage
inputs.description: Whether the arena seals when the fight starts. Locking commits the player; unlocked arenas invite kiting the boss backwards through the dungeon, which is a genre break.

inputs.name: enrageTimerSeconds
inputs.description: Soft enrage after which the fight gets lethal. Zero disables it; without an enrage, patient builds turn every boss into a timer test of the player's bladder, not skill.

inputs.name: initialBeaten
inputs.description: Floors whose boss is already dead, as depths. Arriving on one is not a fight: the encounter reads defeated there and does not engage. Written for a saved run: a build that saves reads the matching output and hands it back here, and the dungeon is as the player left it.

inputs.name: encounters
inputs.description: Optional scripted encounters: [{id, arenaId, level, boss:{archetype, maxHealth, socket?, masteryTags?}, phases, enrage?}]. The first phase enters on engagement. Later phases declare stable id, exactly one enterWhen condition, optional attacks, adds, and hazardPhase. Empty preserves the legacy floor/threshold contract.

inputs.name: playerTeam
inputs.description: Roster team whose elimination fails rather than completes an active scripted encounter.

inputs.name: allowReplay
inputs.description: Whether a completed scripted encounter may start again. Failed and reset encounters may retry; completion ids remain in the durable ledger.

inputs.name: initialStates
inputs.description: Restored per-encounter status, phase and condition ledgers, elapsed time, enrage, living and defeated unit ids, and completion id. Restore emits no engagement, phase, spawn, attack, hazard, failure, completion, or reward events; Unit Roster restores units independently.

outputs.name: currentPhase
outputs.description: Zero-based legacy phase index, or the active scripted phase's zero-based index, for AI and arena consumers. Stable scripted consumers use states[current].phaseId rather than inferring identity from this number.

outputs.name: engaged
outputs.description: True from arena entry until defeat or reset. Every floor is its own encounter: arriving on another floor ends it, and that floor starts unengaged.

outputs.name: defeated
outputs.description: Whether this floor's boss is dead.

outputs.name: arenaLocked
outputs.description: Engaged with lockArenaOnEngage on: the arena is locked. Reported, not enforced; a build's doors enforce it (world.dungeon_doors does).

outputs.name: arena
outputs.description: This floor's arena room as {id, x, y, w, h}, or null when the floor has none.

outputs.name: beaten
outputs.description: Every floor whose boss is dead, as depths: what initialBeaten takes back.

outputs.name: reset
outputs.description: reset(): ends this floor's legacy fight unwon, preserving a dead boss as defeated. For a scripted encounter, resetEncounter(encounterId) performs the equivalent ledger transition, silently removes living owned units, and emits combat.bossEncounterReset without completion or rewards.

outputs.name: states
outputs.description: Per-scripted-encounter idle, active, completed, or failed state, current stable phase id, entered phases, satisfied conditions, spawned and defeated units, enrage, and completion id; the snapshot initialStates accepts.

outputs.name: activeUnits
outputs.description: Living boss and add records owned by the active scripted encounter, including encounterId, phaseId, spawnId, tier, archetype, and masteryTags.

outputs.name: lastRejected
outputs.description: Why a start, condition, phase transition, defeat, or replay was ignored, including stale conditions, unrelated units, and completed encounters.
